title: Wire fleet multi-host mode in serve orchestrator
description: Fleet multi-host mode is dead wiring: config rejects multiple --sandbox-host-addr values and buildNodeOrFleetControl returns not-yet-wired error for len(addrs)>1. Wire FleetSandboxControl construction with multiple sandbox-host addresses so orchestrator can distribute across hosts. FleetSandboxControl is already fully implemented — just needs construction wiring in serve_orchestrator.go and config validation update.

comments.author: Danny Cosson
comments.text: Implemented in commit 0beb54b. Fleet multi-host mode is now wired in cmd/flexagent/serve_orchestrator.go (config validation accepts multiple addresses; buildNodeOrFleetControl constructs FleetSandboxControl for len(addrs)>1). Added tests and ran make check + make test successfully. Ready for review.
